project_type: Python 3.11 library + CLI (uv): build-the-builder compiles bank briefs into a Freya voice-agent workflow (extract PolicySpec with an LLM -> validate -> compile workflow dict -> lint -> offline selfchecks -> optional online test). No server.
language: Python 3.11 (type hints, dataclasses); engine.py is also embedded as source into a platform code node, so it must stay stdlib-only (datetime/json/re), snippet-safe (no class/global, no doubled braces, capped loops).
build_system: uv + pyproject.toml; no compile step. Run everything with `uv run ...` from /Users/melih/Desktop/build-the-builder. build.py is the CLI (`uv run python build.py <briefs> --dry --spec FILE --slot NAME` writes runs/<slot>-<ts>/, which is git-ignored; delete the dirs you create).
test_framework: pytest. Baseline measured at planning time: 679 passed in ~26 s. Must never drop below 679; target >= 740.
build_command: uv run python -c "import builder.compiler, builder.engine, builder.hooks"  (import check) ; real gate is the test command
verification_instructions: See plan section 7: (1) uv run pytest -q; (2) uv run python scripts/check_contamination.py -> '0 strict hit(s), 0 allowlist problem(s)'; (3) uv run python -m builder.spec validate tests/fixtures/<spec>.json -> OK for spec_brief_a, spec_brief_ab, spec_variant_1..3; (4) uv run python scripts/offline_verify.py (created in FEAT-005); (5) dry CLI smoke builds for spec_brief_a and spec_brief_ab; (6) agreement tests tests/test_snippets.py tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_engine.py tests/test_backward_compat.py; (7) git status hygiene.
snapshot_or_generated_files: tests/fixtures/golden_facts.json is a golden snapshot generated by `uv run python -m tests.test_backward_compat --write` from the UNMODIFIED engine (FEAT-001 item 1.1) and must never be regenerated afterwards. tests/fixtures/spec_rehearsal.json is a byte-for-byte copy of runs/rehearsal-20261011-132458/spec.json (never edit it). Nothing else is generated.
environment_constraints: DO NOT git commit/add/stash/reset/push at any point. No Freya/LLM/network calls; never run build.py without --dry. Do not edit tools/, public-test-set.json or freya.py. Never print key values; credentials (if ever needed, not in these steps) come from `set -a && . ./env.sh && set +a`. The relative paths of the repo are the real working tree (there is no separate worktree).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING exists. Binding rules: (a) no value from Brief A/B, the 3 variant briefs or the 2 rehearsal briefs (numbers, dates, field names, enums, sentences, bank/persona names) in builder/, build.py, scripts/ -- tests/ and tests/fixtures/ may hold them; (b) tests/test_contamination.py and scripts/check_contamination.py stay green after every change; test_no_directory_scanning_outside_trace bans the strings 'glob(' and 'iterdir(' in build.py and builder/** except builder/trace.py; (c) schema changes are OPTIONAL fields only; (d) never hand-edit an extracted spec; (e) every policy parameter comes from the spec, a missing one is 'unresolved', never a builder default (only documented exception: DEFAULT_FAREWELL_EN in plan D7).
key_patterns: engine.py = single source of date/amount logic, embedded verbatim in the facts code node by snippets.py (ENGINE_SPEC_KEYS selects spec parts); hooks.py generates import-free hook sources through _assemble(kind, consts, helpers, body) with literal() for constants (no doubled braces) and cfg dicts built by compiler.py; tests/test_hooks.py builds cfg dicts independently and runs hooks through tests/hook_harness.run_hook in 'single' and 'split' exec layouts; selfcheck.py runs spec-derived scenarios on the compiled workflow and tests/test_selfcheck.py has mutation tests that replace literal substrings of hook source (re-target them when rewriting a line); compiler._Build.warn()/gap() fill CompileReport; pipeline._degrade(ctx, msg) writes a loud 'DEGRADED:' trace line; conversation nodes come from _conv_node, code nodes from _code_node, end nodes from tools_gen.end_call_node(name, spoken_message, terminal_name); transitions use _group/_always/_tool_transition; variables are referenced in prompts through tools_gen.placeholder(name).
directory_structure: builder/ (compiler, engine, hooks, snippets, node_prompts, selfcheck, lint, pipeline, extract + extract_prompts/*.md, online_* , tools_gen, spec + spec_schema.json); tests/ (pytest, fixtures/ holds spec_*.json extractions and variant briefs); scripts/ (check_contamination.py, rehearse.py, diff_spec.py, extract_live.py); briefs/ (brief-a.md, brief-b.md); rehearsal/ (brief-1.md, brief-2.md, evidence); runs/ and results/ (git-ignored outputs); tools/ and public-test-set.json are organiser files (read-only); .agents/tasks/ holds plans/reports.
